title: OSBPL10 alleviates neuronal ferroptosis via lysosomal membrane repair in a PS-dependent manner after spinal cord injury.
authors: Zhang, Haojie; Luo, Yiqian; Kang, Yu; Huang, Daoqiang; Zhao, Tianlun; Hu, Xuantao; Di, Jiawei; Yao, Senyu; Pang, Mao; Liu, Bin; Rong, Limin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究OSBPL10通过PS依赖性溶酶体膜修复减轻脊髓损伤后神经元铁死亡，核心为脂质转移与细胞器修复，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Spinal cord injury (SCI) exerts severe adverse effects on patients, leading to impaired motor functions in segments remote from the injury site. Following SCI, lysosomes are damaged due to inflammatory microenvironment, and the repair of such damage requires a substantial supply of lipids. Studies have demonstrated that lipid transfer proteins (LTPs) play a pivotal role in the repair process of neuronal organelles. However, whether these proteins regulate functional recovery after SCI and their underlying mechanisms remain elusive. Through RNA sequencing and human cerebrospinal fluid enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) analyses, we verified that OSBPL10 is significantly downregulated in the acute phase of SCI and may serve as a protective factor against SCI. The Basso Mouse Scale (BMS), Nissl staining, and two-dimensional (2D) gait analysis were employed to evaluate functional recovery. Western blotting and immunofluorescence assays were performed to detect the expression changes of proteins associated with autophagy, ferroptosis, oxidative stress, and lysosomal membrane permeabilization (LMP) related proteins. Finally, molecular docking and rescue experiments using lipid synthesis inhibitors further confirmed that OSBPL10 ameliorate LMP by transferring PS to lysosomes, thereby promoting autophagic flux. Collectively, our findings conclude that OSBPL10 overexpression alleviates autophagic flux impairment, ferroptosis, and oxidative stress after SCI through PS-mediated lysosomal repair, thus facilitating post-injury neurological function recovery and holding promising potential for clinical application.
abstract_zh: 脊髓损伤（SCI）对患者造成严重影响，导致损伤部位远端节段的运动功能受损。SCI后，由于炎症微环境，溶酶体受损，修复此类损伤需要大量脂质供应。研究表明，脂质转移蛋白（LTPs）在神经元细胞器的修复过程中发挥关键作用。然而，这些蛋白是否调节SCI后的功能恢复及其潜在机制仍不清楚。通过RNA测序和人类脑脊液酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）分析，我们验证了OSBPL10在SCI急性期显著下调，并可能作为SCI的保护因子。采用Basso小鼠量表（BMS）、尼氏染色和二维（2D）步态分析评估功能恢复。通过Western blotting和免疫荧光实验检测自噬、铁死亡、氧化应激及溶酶体膜透化（LMP）相关蛋白的表达变化。最后，分子对接和脂质合成抑制剂的救援实验进一步证实，OSBPL10通过将PS转移至溶酶体改善LMP，从而促进自噬流。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，OSBPL10过表达通过PS介导的溶酶体修复减轻SCI后的自噬流障碍、铁死亡和氧化应激，从而促进损伤后神经功能恢复，并具有临床应用的巨大潜力。
